name: School Of Freelancing Agent
description: Freelancing training and support, plus Linux and AI services. Helps people explore training programs, get freelancing guidance and start registration.

skills.name: Freelancing training information
skills.description: Explains School Of Freelancing training programs and how to get started as a freelancer.
examples: What freelancing training programs do you offer?
How do I land my first freelance client?

skills.name: Freelancing support
skills.description: Answers freelancing questions on pricing, proposals and client work.
examples: How should I price my freelance services?
Help me write a proposal for a client

skills.name: Linux and AI services
skills.description: Describes available Linux, IT and AI services and how to request one.
examples: What Linux or AI services can I request?
I need help setting up an AI workflow

skills.name: Registration help
skills.description: Guides a person through registration. Payment confirmation always requires explicit human action.
examples: How do I register for a training program?
